AutofillError.description: If the autofill job fails, this object provides details about the error.

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.

x-enum-descriptions: The service encountered an error when autofilling your brand template.
The service encountered an error when generating a thumbnail for the autofilled design.
The service encountered an error when saving the autofilled design.
The service encountered an error when applying design approval settings to the autofilled design.
The user has exceeded their autofill trial quota.
The service encountered an error when saving the updated design.

AutofillTrialInformation.description:
WARNING: Trials and trial information are a [preview feature](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/#preview-apis).
There might be unannounced breaking changes to this feature which won't produce a new API version.

Trial information for users on a Canva plan that doesn't include autofill access. These
users have a limited number of autofill uses. Once the trial is exhausted, users must
upgrade their Canva plan (such as to Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise) to
continue using the Autofill API.

uses_remaining.description: The number of uses remaining in the free trial.

upgrade_url.description: The URL for a user to upgrade their Canva account to a plan with autofill access.

CreateDesignAutofillJobResult.description: A new autofilled design has been created and saved to the user's root folder.

id.description: ID of the asynchronous job that is creating the design using the provided data.

DesignAutofillJobResult.description: Result of the design autofill job. Only present if job status is `success`.

DesignAutofillStatus.description: Status of the design autofill job.

DesignLinks.description: A temporary set of URLs for viewing or editing the design.

edit_url.description:
A temporary editing URL for the design. This URL is only accessible to the user that made the API request, and is designed to support [return navigation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/return-navigation-guide/) workflows.

NOTE: This is not a permanent URL, it is only valid for 30 days.

view_url.description:
A temporary viewing URL for the design. This URL is only accessible to the user that made the API request, and is designed to support [return navigation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/return-navigation-guide/) workflows.

NOTE: This is not a permanent URL, it is only valid for 30 days.

DesignSummary.description: Basic details about the design, such as the design's ID, title, and URL.

created_at.description:
When the design was created in Canva, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix
Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the design was last updated in Canva, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the
Unix Epoch).

page_count.description: The total number of pages in the design. Some design types don't have pages (for example, Canva docs).

Thumbnail.description: A thumbnail image representing the object.

width.description: The width of the thumbnail image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the thumbnail image in pixels.

url.description:
A URL for retrieving the thumbnail image.
This URL expires after 15 minutes. This URL includes a query string
that's required for retrieving the thumbnail.

UpdateDesignAutofillJobResult.description: The existing design has been autofilled in place.
